claude.performance_metric: acquired by GlobalWafers at US$12.00/share cash; deregistered Dec 2016; no public record for ~2017-2019 window
claude.rationale: The registrant was acquired by GlobalWafers via scheme of arrangement and deregistered in December 2016, before the fixed ~2017-2019 outcome window opened, and no separate public periodic reporting exists for that horizon (last 10-K was FY2015; Form 25 and Form 15-12B filed December 2016). The slice therefore documents no realized product/process disruption over time (p4) and no realized process/organization fracture over time (p5), only a terminal change of control. While the board resigned and the CEO was terminated at closing, these are change-of-control events, not documented post-deal integration fractures within the outcome window; with no audited trajectory for ~2017-2019, both pathways are coded uncertain.
